purpose: Define the bounded structural, outcome and verifier checks required before selecting SFT data or running fixed-policy RL feasibility.
evidence_boundary: This protocol fixes audit strata and stop rules; it does not acquire sources, execute external corpus code, admit rows, update a policy or authorize GPU work.
audit_order: Bind source revisions, terms, component lineage and held-out family identities.
Run the deterministic structural SFT audit and freeze row/task-family exclusions.
Run bounded independent outcome and tool-trajectory checks on eligible rows only.
Bind supervised/context token counts and matched SFT strata for the two research arms.
Measure reasoning-mode and budget-control behavior on a useful SFT parent without creating a launch arm.
Qualify fixed-policy RL prompts, verifiers and deterministic tool controls after a useful SFT parent exists.

sft_structural_audit.coverage: Census every row; deterministic sample within each source/subset; preserve source/subset identities and file hashes.
required_outputs: complete-row fit at each context ceiling
sft_structural_audit.boundary: Structural and length evidence only; it does not establish correctness, source rights, contamination clearance or arm eligibility.

sft_outcome_panel.minimum_panel: 32 eligible rows per nonempty source/category stratum, with all known-invalid, unresolved and held rows excluded from the accepted panel and counted separately.
stop_rules: No independent oracle: keep the row unresolved.
A source-family or benchmark join is unresolved: quarantine the connected family.
Structural validity without outcome evidence cannot promote a row.

tool_trajectory_panel.minimum_panel: 64 complete candidate trajectories per nonempty agent subset when supply permits; retain every rejection reason and do not backfill from another subset.
tool_trajectory_panel.environment_control: Run the existing five deterministic golden tool scenarios before interpreting source trajectories. A passing control verifies the evaluator, not the data.
stop_rules: Unresolved tool calls or missing parameter schemas remain rejected.
No recovery case: do not claim agent reliability.
Adapter-only conversion remains a format intervention and must be reported separately.

conditions: explicit hybrid mode only when both modes are represented in training data
three task-matched requested budgets with actual reasoning-token counts
required_measurements: correctness and tool success by task family
quality per generated token and per wall-clock cost
mode-following, format, truncation and long-task regression rates
reasoning_control_panel.promotion_rule: Keep the always-thinking baseline if a candidate mode or budget bucket does not improve its intended quality-cost frontier without regressions.
reasoning_control_panel.boundary: Evaluation and fixed-policy measurement only; no new SFT arm, policy update or release interface is authorized.

rl_feasibility_panel.parent: Selected SFT checkpoint after the SFT comparison or documented baseline-only outcome.
rl_feasibility_panel.selection: Deterministic family-stratified sample from eligible prompts; keep the 60-row long-context probe outside the initial 16K path because all inspected queries exceed 32K.
required_controls: reasoning-token length and quality-cost Pareto measurements
truncation, repetition, shortcut and verifier-hacking controls
outputs: correctness-first length-efficiency curves by task family
rl_feasibility_panel.boundary: No policy updates, RL-data ablation or production RL commitment.

decision_boundary.sft_arm_launch: Requires accepted manifest, independent outcome panel, source/task-family partitions, supervised-token target, useful parent and measured cost.
decision_boundary.rl_feasibility_launch: Requires selected SFT parent, eligible prompt/reference manifest, valid verifier controls, deterministic environment and budget receipt.
decision_boundary.negative_result: Report baseline-only or inconclusive outcomes; do not replace unresolved rows with undisclosed samples.

admission_boundary: This is an audit protocol only. It does not admit downstream data, authorize corpus execution, start SFT/RL, or change the 170-GPU-hour research reservation.
